image_description: A male mallard duck (drake) floating on calm water. The duck has a distinctive iridescent green head, a white neck ring, a grey body, and a yellow bill. It is swimming with its body low in the water and head elevated. The reflection of the duck is visible in the water.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Most distinctive feature is the broad, flat bill adapted for filter-feeding; bill is dark grey to yellow-green.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The duck has a clearly visible yellow bill that is broad and flat, matching the description.
The eye is visible and appears dark against the green head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is stocky and compact, streamlined and buoyant with dense waterproof plumage.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body appears stocky and compact, floating properly on the water with dense plumage.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Breeding plumage is typically more colorful than female: common patterns include iridescent green head with white neck ring and grey body (mallard), or chestnut head with grey body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The duck displays the classic mallard drake pattern: iridescent green head, white neck ring, and grey body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Legs are short and set far back on the body with webbed feet (three forward toes connected by webbing).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: One orange webbed foot is visible in the water, showing the characteristic webbing. The leg position appears correct for a swimming duck.
The wings are folded against the body and appear broad and pointed as expected.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is short with curled central tail feathers (drake feathers) in many species.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visible and shows the characteristic curled central feathers typical of male mallards.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The water ripples appear slightly uniform and stylized, lacking the natural randomness of real water movement. Some areas show subtle texture inconsistencies.
The reflection is somewhat blurry and lacks the precise detail that would be expected from a real water reflection, though this could be due to water movement.
